subject: Re: Aligning demo so CTO can join — timezone bridge options
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@quantalytiq.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Cho <ben.cho@quantalytiq.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Demo this Thu — CTO travel conflict, can we shift so they can join?

Hi Karthik,

Quick one — our CTO (Oliver) will be in transit for the originally scheduled demo on Thu (Dec 9, 16:00 UTC) and strongly wants to join for the architecture & latency discussion. Is there any chance Redwood can move the demo to accommodate? Ideally Oliver can join between 14:00–16:00 UTC on Dec 9, but we have flexibility if we can do a short timezone bridge to get him on for the first 30 minutes and then hand off to your team.

We want both the exec-level overview (VP/CTO) and the technical deep dive, so if splitting the session works that could be an option.

Also: we have a small SOC2 questionnaire that came up — I’ve attached it. Would appreciate a quick confirmation of what you can cover.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Product Ops, Quantalytiq
samira@quantalytiq.com

Attachment: Quantalytiq-SOC2-questions.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@quantalytiq.com>
Cc: Ben Cho <ben.cho@quantalytiq.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo this Thu — CTO travel conflict, can we shift so they can join?

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and for the SOC2 doc.

We can absolutely make this work. Two pragmatic options that keep your CTO present for the most critical pieces:

1) Timezone-bridge (preferred) — Move the start to 15:00 UTC. Oliver joins for first 30 minutes (exec overview + SLA/latency summary). Marissa will cover the deep technical walkthrough immediately after and stay on for Q&A. Total session remains 60 minutes.

2) Split session — 30-minute exec session at 14:30 UTC with Oliver, followed by a 60-minute technical deep dive at 17:00 UTC (different attendees ok). This keeps the exec overview focused but requires two separate calendar blocks.

Marissa is copied and can confirm availability for the hands-on portion. If you prefer option 1 I’ll send an updated invite and include a short run-of-show; I’ve also attached a draft agenda and an .ics for the proposed coverage slot.

We can also add Rishi if you want VP-level presence from our side for the exec portion — he’s flexible but wants a quick heads-up.

Proposed items I’ll include in the invite: run-of-show (15 mins exec), latency/cost tradeoffs (15 mins), demo (20 mins), Q&A (10 mins).

Which of the two options works best for you?

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.docx (DOCX, 48KB); demo-coverage-proposal.ics (calendar invite stub)

- I’ll need access to the Quantalytiq architecture diagram ahead of the call (link or a one-pager).
- If Oliver can join for the first 30 minutes, I’ll plan to be online for the full hour to field the deep questions.
- Vanessa, can you send a calendar invite and include a dial-in that supports both PST and CET?
